notes: Investment gold, silver and platinum of at least 99% purity (tradable on international bullion market) is zero-rated; jewelry and lower-purity metal carry 15% VAT. No local dealer ask prices could be opened, so bar premiums, making charges and buyback are null.

sources.name: ZATCA investment metals VAT guideline
sources.what: Investment gold/silver/platinum (99%+ purity) zero-rated; jewelry subject to 15% standard VAT

sources.name: ZATCA news notice
sources.what: Notice that VAT applies to gold below 99% purity

sources.name: Saudi Gazette
sources.what: Report (21 Jul 2025): zero VAT at 99%+ purity, VAT below 99%
